units.source_text: 此外，童男童女要吃“特别灶”。

en.t: In addition, the boy and girl attendants had to eat food prepared on a "special stove."

units.source_text: 就是说，他们吃的东西，要用与家人不同的炉灶来烧，以表示洁净的意思。

en.t: That is to say, the food they ate had to be cooked on a hearth separate from the family's, as a sign of purity.

units.source_text: 如今这些规矩都省略了，据说只把童男童女的食物，用火镰打火 [2] 烧烧就算了。

en.t: Nowadays all these rules have been omitted; it is said that it is enough simply to light a fire with a flint striker [2] and briefly heat the attendants' food.

units.source_text: 也有这样的传说：有的人家，家人无意中忘记了，童男童女就会催促说：“火镰，火镰。”

en.t: There is also this kind of legend: in some households, if the family accidentally forgot, the boy and girl attendants would urge them on, saying, "The flint striker, the flint striker."
